idea: Routines & independence #2 – getting dressed for the cold (HOUSE OUTSIDE, on the porch by the round red front door): the very first snowflakes of the season fall and a big sparkly snowflake lands right on Baby Ava's nose ('Oh! A snowflake! Brrr! So cold!'); chorus 'Jacket, hat and mittens! Warm, warm, warm!'; she dresses herself step by step – 'My jacket on! Zip, zip, zip!', 'My hat on my head! Pull it down!', 'Mittens on my hands! Clap, clap, clap!'; 'I did it myself!'; she asks the viewer 'What goes on my head? Hmm?' (pause) – 'My hat! Yay! Warm and cozy!'; lesson 'Dress up warm when it is cold!'. Loop: the hook framing again, the snowflake on her nose, now fully dressed and giggling, bye-bye wave with her pink mitten.
title: Brrr! It's Snowing! ❄️ Jacket, Hat & Mittens with Baby Ava | Get Dressed for Winter | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh! A snowflake lands on Baby Ava's nose! ❄️ Brrr, it's cold! Sing along with Baby Ava as she gets dressed all by herself to stay warm: jacket, hat and mittens.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh! A snowflake! Brrr! So cold!"
🧥 My jacket on! Zip, zip, zip!
🧶 My hat on my head! Pull it down!
🧤 Mittens on my hands! Clap, clap, clap!
🤔 "What goes on my head?" – can you answer?
👋 Dress up warm when it is cold! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: getting dressed by yourself • jacket • hat • mittens • warm and cold • winter clothes

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A cozy sing-along getting-dressed song for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Ava on the porch of the Crayon House when the first snowflakes fall – she zips up her jacket, pulls on her hat and claps in her mittens, all by herself.
